lines.text:
Hi! Remember me?
I’m one of Professor Oak’s assistants.\c
The professor told me that if your Pokédex has
good data on 40 species of Pokémon, I’m to
give you this special Ball Set U.\c
So, [VAR TRNAME(0000)], let me ask you...\c
Have you gathered data on at least 40 species
of Pokémon?

Great!
You have caught [VAR NUM3(0004)] species of Pokémon!\c
Congratulations!
Then here you go!
You got 30 Ultra Balls from the assistant!

It’s very easy to catch Pokémon
with an Ultra Ball.\c
As for a Poké Ball that makes it even easier
to catch Pokémon than an Ultra Ball...\c
Well, I hear Silph Co. may or may not
be working on just such a thing.

Let’s see...\c
Uh-oh! You’ve only caught [VAR NUM3(0004)] different species
of Pokémon!\c
You’ve got to reach 40 species if you want this
Ball Set U from me.
...Oh, I see.\c\nWhen you get 40 species of Pokémon, come\nback for the Ball Set U.
